result.topic_en: The page argues that, for the laws (4) and (5) to hold for general derivatives with ordinary differentiation as a special case, derivatives must satisfy a Taylor-type expansion of z(x+h) in powers h^ν/Πν, and restricts them to series in fractional powers of h in which each coefficient is the differential of the preceding one.
